s: Meqom veseder lishat hammatztzot ubo l"b seipim: en lashin haissa shel pesach bemaqom shehashshemesh zoreach sham, shechom hashshemesh mechammem haissa ubeqal tukal labo lide chimmutz. Abal bimqom hatztzel — muttar lalush, apillu tachat avir haraqia im eno yom hamunnan, abal beyom hamunnan asur lalush tachat kol avir haraqia apillu bimqom tzel, lepi shehachamma boqaat bekol maqom, veenah yotzea derek challon keneged challonah, sheheabim omedim bepaneha vehi mitpashshetet alehem uboqaat bekol pissuq shebbahem:
Vaapillu babbayit asur lalush beyom hamunnan keneged challon patuach, ap al pi shehashshemesh lo yukal lizroach letoko leolam, kegon shehu patuach leruach tzapon:

Venahagu lizzaher shello lalush keneged challon patuach apillu beyom sheeno meunnan vegam hashshemesh lo yukal lizroach letoko, mikkol maqom yesh lachosh shemma pitom yitkassu hashshamayim beabim veyihyeh yom hamunnan vehu lo yargish baddabar sheyyasir miyyad et haissa mikkeneged hachallon, mah sheen ken keshellash tachat avir haraqia im yabou ananim vetitkasseh hachamma, miyyad yargish baddabar veyaknis haissa labbayit miyyad:
Vekol zeh keneged hachallon mammash, abal min hatztzad shel challon — muttar lalush apillu im hashshemesh zoreach letok hachallon vehu lash batztzel qarob limqom zerichat hashshemesh:
Vekol zeh bechallon patuach mammash, abal im hu satum bizkukit ap al pi shehashshemesh zoreach sham — muttar lalush kenegdo (umikkol maqom, tzarik lizzaher shello techammem haissa):

Yesh lizzaher keshemmolik qemach shel pesach bayyom, veken keshemmolik hammatztzot lattannur leepotan bayyom — lo yolikem megullin tachat avir haraqia im hu yom hamunnan, veen tzarik lomar shello yolikem megullin bimqom zerichat hashshemesh, ella yekasseh otan bemappa. Veen lekassot peamim harbeh bemappa achat, deshemma nidbaq bah meat batzeq venitchammetz (kesheshshaha kede hilluk mil) kemo sheyyitbaer. Veim molikan ballayla, o apillu beben hashshemashot — en tzarik lekassotan kelal (ayyen siman tn"h):

Lo yitqareb lalush etzel pi hattannur mippene chom hattannur shemmechammem haissa, abal meachorayv o mitztziddayv muttar lalush. Bammeh debarim amurim? Betannur sheopin bo, shehu asuy millebenim abim veen chummo sholet chutz ledapnotayv, abal tannur bet hachorep shehussaq — en lalush besamuk lo mikkol tzedadayv, lepi shehu machaziq chummo beyoter umitpashshet chummo chutz ledapnotayv. Veap berichuq mimmennu im margishim sham chom hahassaqa — en lalush beoto bayit, ad sheyyiptach haddelet vehachallonot sheyyetze hachom. Lepikak, nakon shello lehassiq tannur bet hachorep bo bayyom:
Abar velash tachat hashshemesh o samuk lattannur, im al yede ken huchamma haissa — asura baakila, veim lav — mutteret apillu lash bemezid:

Lekattechilla asur lehaniach haissa belo eseq apillu rega echad, vekol zeman sheoseqin babbatzeq apillu kol hayyom kullo — eno ba lide chimmutz. Veim henichuhu belo eseq kede hilluk mil — hare zeh chametz. Veim shaha pachot mimmil vechazar venitasseq vechazar veshaha pachot mimmil — en hashshehiyyot mitztorpot likde hilluk mil, shehaeseq shemmitasseq bo benetayim mebattel et hachimmutz meat shehitchil lehitchammetz bashshehiyya harishona. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennitasseq beeseq gamur, kegon beitat hayyadayim baissa, o hariddud shemmeraddedin hammatztzot beetz agol, abal hanniqqur shemmenaqqerin hammatztzot kede shello yitpechu — eno niqra eseq gamur lebattel hachimmutz meat shehitchil kebar lehitchammetz bashshehiyya harishona. Umikkol maqom, niqra eseq qetzat leinyan sheen hammatztza ba lide chametz bishat hanniqqur. Abal mah shennohagin hamon am kesheroin matztza haasuya munnachat vei epshar leepotah miyyad lepi sheadayin lo garepu haggechalim min hattannur o mippene sheen lah maqom battannur, ukede shello tabo lide chimmutz meshapshepin bah beyadayim — en zeh moil kelum, veadderabba hayyad mechammemet et habbatzeq umemaher lehachmitz (ulekak yesh lizzaher shello lehanniach hayyad al habbatzeq shello letzorek), ayyen siman tn"v. Ella ketzad yaaseh (im mityare shello tishheh shiur mil chutz lattannur vetachmitz)? Yishberenna veyaasenna chatikat batzeq veyachazor vitaqqenah kebattechilla, kede shehaeseq yebattel hachimmutz. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla tob lizzaher shello yabo lide kak, sheyyesh lachosh shemma kesheyyetaqqenah paam sheniyya lo yaarok otah yapeh yapeh shettihyeh gush mammash, ella yihyeh bah sedaqim ukepilut, vahare zeh keen matztza kepula shennohagin leesor, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"a. Lepikak, yesh lehizzaher lekattechilla shello lehatchil lehaarik hammatztzot uleraddedam ad sheyyatchilu ligrop haggechalim min hattannur kede sheyyukelu leepot miyyad. Vegam mittechilla lo yatchilu lalush haissa ad zeman ma achar shehussaq hattannur, bikde shemmiyyad achar hallisha yukelu ligrop hattannur ulehatchil lehaarik hammatztzot veleepotan miyyad. Vekol zeh lekattechilla, abal bediabad en leesor ella im ken nishtaha shiur mil belo eseq:

Shiur mil hu rebiit shaa vecheleq esrim, shehare ameru chakamim: mahalak adam benoni beyom benoni, dehaynu bime nisan vetishre shehayyom vehallayla shavin, hu arbaim mil, vehayyom y"b shaot, techalleq hay"b shaot learbaim mil yaggia lekol mil rebiit shaa vecheleq esrim mishshaa, shehare eser shaot shekkeshettechalleqem lem' chalaqim yaggia lekol cheleq rebiit shaa, vehab' shaot keshettechalleqem learbaim chalaqim yaggia lekol cheleq esrim mishshaa. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim sheshshiur mil hu shene chumshe shaa, lepi sheyyesh omerim sheyyeme nisan vetishre sheadam yakol lahalok bahem arbaim mil meammud hashshachar ad tzet hakkokabim yesh bahem yoter mi"b shaot benonit (perush otan shaot sheyyesh mehen k"d bemeet leet niqrain shaot benonit, lepi sheyyesh shaot zemanniyyot shennitbaer besiman n"ch), veenan niqrain yamim benonim ella lepi shemmehanetz hachamma ad sheqiatah hu kemo mishsheqiatah ad henetzah, ulepi zeh al korchak yesh mehanetz hachamma ad sheqiatah y"b shaot benonit, shehare hammeet leet hu k"d shaot benonit, umehanetz hachamma ad sheqiatah en adam yakol lehallek ki im sheloshim mil, im ken maggia lekol mil shene chumshe shaa, shehare bey"b shaot yesh bahem shishshim chumshin, techalleqem lishloshim chalaqim yaggia lekol cheleq shene chumshin. Uleinyan halaka, haiqqar kassebara haacharona, umikkol maqom, yesh lehachamir kassebara harishona im en sham hepsed merubbeh:

Lo ameru chakamim shiur mil ella kesheadayin lo nitchammem habbatzeq al yede eseq hayyadayim, abal leachar shennitchammem al yede eseq hayyadayim, im yenichuhu belo eseq — miyyad yachmitz. Veken bemaqom cham, kegon samuk lepi hattannur sheopin bo, o shellash bebayit shehussaq bo tannur bet hachorep umargishin chummo adayin, im shaha habbatzeq belo eseq yakol labo lide chimmutz apillu bepachot mishshiur mil. Veken bekol maqom shemmargishin bo chom qetzat, ulepi yitron hachamimut memaher hu lehachmitz, vetzarik latet leb lepi hainyan:

Im hitchilu lalush b' issot keachat vehechmitza achat mehen qodem sheshshahata shiur mil belo eseq, kegon shenniru bah simane chimmutz sheyyitbaer, beyadua shehechmitza gam hashshenit im shahata kol kak kemo chabertah. Ap al pi shello shahata shiur mil vegam lo niru bah simane chimmutz, mikkol maqom kevan shennitchammetza achat mehen, beyadua sheyyesh sham ezeh chamimut shemmemaher lehachmitz qodem shiur mil:

Batzeq shehechmitz ad sheyyesh bo sedaqim, apillu lo nitarebu hassedaqim zeh bazeh ella echad holek henna veechad holek henna — hare zeh chametz gamur, vehaokelo chayyab karet. Vaapillu en sedaqim nireh ella bemiqtzat haissa — hare kol haissa chametz gamur. Veim en bo shum sedeq ella shehiksipu panayv (perush mareh laban hannoteh leshacharut sheqqorin blyykly"k bel"a) keadam sheamedu saarotayv mittok pachad varetet sheppanayv maksipin, dehaynu shennishtannet tzurato — hare zeh asur baakila ubahanaa middibre soperim kechametz gamur, vehu niqra chametz nuqsheh, sheeno rauy laakila mechamat chamitzuto shello gamar kol tzorko (ayyen siman tm"b). Vetzarik limchot bahamon am shemmashhin haissot ad shemmaksipin penehem:

Im haishsha shellasha hi opa beatzmah, keshettabo lalush od leachar sheopta issa harishona — tzerika hi letzannen yadeha bemayim tzonenin qodem shettalush, lepi sheyyadeha nitchammemu mechom hattannur umechammemim et haissa. Veim obra velo tzinnena yadeha qodem hallisha — happat mutteret:

Im haishsha shellasha hi meqattepet (perush shettacha pene hacharara bemayim qodem haapiyya) — lo teqattep beotan mayim shemmetzannenet bahem yadeha, mippene shehem mitchammemin mechom yadeha umachmitzin et hacharara, ella yehe lah keli acher male mayim shetteqattep bahem. Ubimdinot ellu en nohagin kelal leqattep hammatztzot bemayim. Umikkol maqom, im era kak — en oserin hammatztza baakila:

Im lash achar zeman issur chametz, dehaynu mittechillat shaa shishshit vaelak — tzarik lizzaher bammayim sherochatzin bahem haareba im shear hakkelim sheshshimmeshu baissa ubammayim shemmeqattepet bahen ubammayim shemmetzannenet bahem yadeha, shello yishpekem ella bimqom midron, kede sheyyibbaleu mehera baqqarqa. Abal im shopekan shello bimqom midron — yesh lachosh shemma yitqabbetzu bemaqom echad veyachmitzu qodem sheyyibbaleu baqqarqa, venimtza sheyyihyeh chametz birshuto bepesach. Vaapillu im shopekan lirshut harabbim venimtzeu sheyyatzeu mereshuto qodem shennitchammetzu, mikkol maqom kevan shekkebar higgia zeman issur chametz — tzarik hu lizzaher lekattechilla bekol asher yesh lo shello yabou lide chimmutz kelal:
Velo yishpekem al gabbe ritzpat abanim apillu hi midron, shehare enam niblain baqqarqa bimhera:

Kebar nitbaer shellekattechilla asur lehashhot habbatzeq belo eseq apillu pachot mishshiur mil, lepikak kol hakkelim hamshammeshim baissa, kegon haarebot vehassakkin shechotekin bo haissa vaatze megalgelin shemmeraddedin bahem hammatztzot veetzim shemmenaqqerin bahem hammatztzot — tzarik lizzaher legordam yapeh ben kol issa veissa, lenaqqotam mipperure batzeq hannidbaqim bahem. Ap al pi sheen shohin shiur mil ben kol issa veissa, venimtza shehabbatzeq haddabuq bakkelim eno shohe belo eseq, ap al pi ken lekattechilla tzarik lizzaher bekak. Veim en shohin kelal ben issa leissa, ella lash miyyad zo achar zo belo hepseq kelal, veen hakkelim penuyim mimmelaktam kelal, venimtza shehabbatzeq haddabuq bakkelim eno shohe kelum belo eseq — en tzarik legordam ben issa leissa:

Veachar gemar lishat haissot hanneepot behesseq tannur echad, keshechozer umassiqo leepot bo paam shenit — yadiach kol hakkelim sheshshimmeshu baissa vinaggebem lachazor ulehishtammesh bahem paam shenit, velo day lahem bigrida bilbad kemo shennohagin haolam, ki i epshar lenaqqotam legamre al yede gerida bilbad. Veim hu yom tob sheasur lehadiach kelim sheen lo tzorek lehishtammesh bahem od bo bayyom — yedichem al yede nokri, shehahadacha shello letzorek yom tob hi shebut vehaamira lenokri hu shebut dishbut, ushebut dishbut lo gazeru bimqom mitzva, dehaynu lebaer ulehaabir hechametz haddabuq bakkelim:

Veim en sham nokri lehadicham — day lo bebittul sheyyebattel veyapqir habbatzeq haddabuq bakkelim qodem shennitchammetz, sheaz hu adayin birshuto lebattelo ulehapqiro. Veap kesheyyitchammetz achar kak — en tzarik lehaabiro ulebaaro im bekol keli ukeli bipne atzmo en bo kezayit batzeq dabuq, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"b ayyen sham. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla tzarik hu lizzaher shello yabo lide chimmutz kelal, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Lepikak im en sham nokri — yetilem lemayim tzonenim shehatztzonenim moneim millehachmitz, veyizzaher lehakbidam lematta betok hammayim, veal yatzupu lemala:

Vekol zeh kesheen dato lachazor veleepot od matztzot, venimtza shehakkelim sheshshimmeshu baissa en lo od tzorek beyom tob atzmo, ulekak asur leyisrael lehadicham. (Veap al pi shelletzorek mitzvat biur chametz muttar lehadiach kelim apillu beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"d, mikkol maqom kan kevan sheyyesh taqqana shello yabo lide chimmutz kelal — lo hittiru lehadiach kelim sheen bahen od tzorek beyom tob). Abal kesheddato lachazor veleepot od matztzot paam shenit beyom tob atzmo — muttar lehadiach kol hakkelim achar apiyya harishona, kevan shehen tzerikin lo od beyom tob atzmo. Lepikak muttar lehadiach et haareba ap al pi sheen dato lachazor veleepot od matztzot bo bayyom, dekevan sheyyesh lah tok yakol hu litten betokah debarim acherim bo bayyom, venimtza shehi tzerika lo beyom tob atzmo:

Abal asur leyisrael ligrod et haareba o shear kol hakkelim, ap al pi sheddato lachazor veleepot bo bayyom venimtza sheggerida zo hi letzorek yom tob atzmo, ap al pi ken lo hittiruhu, lepi sheissur haggerida hu mippene shehu memacheq haetz kemo shennitbaer besiman shk"g, umechiqa en bah tzorek yom tob kelal, shehare epshar lehaabir habbatzeq mehakkelim belo mechiqat haetz, kegon al yede hadacha:

Yesh lizzaher lekattechilla shello litten haareba shellashin bah al gabbe kar o keset shel tzemer bishat hallisha, lepi shehen mechammemin et haareba vehi mechammemet et haissa shebbetokah. Abal muttar litten otah al gabbe beged shel tzemer o al gabbe kar o keset shel or, lepi sheenan mechammemin kol kak:

Im haissa hi rakka meod shennatenu bah mayim yoter min harauy — en lehosip qemach letok hallisha kede shettehe haissa karauy, lepi shehaqqemach shemmosipin yesh lachosh bo shemma en kullo nillosh venigbal yapeh ad sheyyihyeh kullo batzeq, ella nishar mimmennu meat qemach beayin betok haissa, vaapillu leachar apiyya odennu beayin, veshemma lo niqla oto qemach yapeh (shehaqqemach shenniqla yapeh eno ba lide chimmutz kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"g), veyesh lachosh shemma yabo letok hattabshil bepesach veyitchammetz. Ella ketzad yaaseh? Yalush adam acher od issa acheret qetanna meggibbul qasheh vibeshut mayim viareb otah im haissa harakka hamluchlechet shennittosep bah mayim, viqabbelu zo mizzo vezo mizzo lachluchit vibeshut ad sheyyaggia lemidda benonit. Abal adam echad en lo lalush shettehen keachat, shei epshar lalush shette issot keachat ulehitasseq bahen yapeh:

Ubediabad sheabar vehosip qemach baissa harakka — mutteret baakila. Ella shellekattechilla yesh lizzaher bammatztzot hallalu shello yabou letok dabar lach, shello yitchammetz haqqemach shebbetokan. Abal kesheokelan keshehen yebeshot, veap shelloasan beshinnayv — en haroq machmitzo, kevan sheen shohin bappeh shiur mil. Abal bediabad sheabar veasa mehen tabshil — muttar baakila, shehare en kan ella chashasha beolma, shemma nishar meat qemach beayin, veshemma lo niqla yapeh. Abal matztza sheyyodea shennillosh betokah qemach — yesh lehachamir apillu bediabad sheabar unetanah letok dabar lach, ayyen siman ts"g:

Tzarik lizzaher leharchiq hammatztzot min haqqemach, ki haqqemach hannidbaq bahen ba achar kak letok hattabshil umitchammetz. Velaken oto hammoded qemach letok haareba — lo yiqrab el haissot ad sheyyenaqqeh malbushayv miqqemach veyadiach yadayv techilla:

Hamdaqdeqim nohagin lalush besepel, veachar kol issa veissa yadiach hassepel vinaggebo bemappa, ella im ken lash miyyad beli hepseq. Vehamminhag hannakon lihyot lo shene sepalim, lehachalip ben issa leissa:
Oto shellash haissa veotan shettiqqenu hammatztzot (veken oto shennoten haqqemach) yadichu yedehem ben kol issa veissa (ella im ken mitasseqin miyyad beli hepseq kelal):

Vetzarik lizzaher lebaer happerurin meal hashshulchan achar kol issa veissa. Veim yesh bo neqeb o sedeq — tzarik lesotman shello yikkanes bahen batzeq veyachmitz sham veachar kak yitareb baissa. Ulepi sherob hashshulchanot yesh bahem sedaqim, lepikak yesh nohagim laasot hammatztza al hassadin. Vesadin sheasu alayv matztzot paam achat, im rotzeh laasot alayv paam b' — lo day lo bahadacha, lepi shehechametz nidbaq bo, ella tzarik lekabbeso heteb. Vaapillu lo asa matztzot bappaam ha' ella al eber echad shel hassadin — en lo lehapeko laasot al eber hashsheni belo kibbus, lepi shehechametz mebatzbetz veyotze meeber al eber. Veqodem hakkibbus tzarik lehattir kol hattepirot shebbo, kemo shennitbaer besiman tn"g, chutz min hattepirot shebbaimera sheen tzarik lehattir, lepi sheen derek laasot matztzot al haimera ella beemtza hassadin. Veim abar veasa alayv matztzot belo kibbus, im hu tok happesach — yesh leosran, kevan shechametz bepesach bemashshehu, veqarob levadday shennitareb bahen perur mashshehu. Ak im hapak hassadin o shekkibbeso, ap shello hittir hattepirot — en lehachamir veleesor hammatztzot:

Haareba shellashin bah — yesh lizzaher shello yihyeh bah shum gumma vesedeq shello yukal lenaqqeram achar hallisha. Vaapillu al sepatah lo yihyeh shum gumma vesedeq shello yukal lenaqqeram, lepi shehabbatzeq hanniknas sham mitchammetz kesheshshoheh shiur mil, veachar kak keshechozer velash bah mitareb batzeq zeh baissa. Veketzad yaaseh? Im yesh sedaqim baareba — yarchib otam kerochab etzba o pachot, kede sheyyukal lenaqqeram heteb, veachar kak yistemem veyachaliqem lehashvotam yapeh:

Veken hammardeh shemmaknisin bah happat lattannur umotziin bah min hattannur tehe chalaqa beli shum sedeq vegumma, shello yikkanes lesham batzeq veyitchammetz. Abal keshehi chalaqa en batzeq mitdabbeq bah kelal, velaken en tzarik lehadichah kelal achar gemar haapiyya ap shetztzerika lo lachazor veleepot bo paam acheret:
